provenance.notes: The people, organizations, workpiece dimensions, shop capability numbers, and bushing fixture data are invented. Bushing tables are synthetic dimensional stand-ins for a user upload, not an actual supplier datasheet. Original SVG sketches are redistributable. Nothing is physically machined or dispatched.

title: Repeatable pilot-hole jig for furniture assembly rails
summary: A furniture maker supplies a workpiece envelope, two-hole table, fictional bushing data, and clamp limits for a reusable top-registering jig.
